text_block_list.name: Dober's Friend
text_block_list.text:
By the way, I heard a teen magazine<n>is coming to
do a story on the<n>academy soon.

text_block_list.name: Dober's Friend
text_block_list.text:
You must've seen the articles before,<n>right? They
sometimes publish stories<n>on Tracen students and
stuff.

text_block_list.name: Dober's Friend
text_block_list.text:
A while ago, they featured me running<n>in a
magazine spread, and I was sooo<n>happy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: A whole spread?! In a teen<n>magazine?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
choice_data_list: Why are you hiding behind me?
Why are you hiding behind me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I-I'm not hiding! I just happened to<n>be here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I don't want to be featured in a<n>magazine spread...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Even after being called out, Mejiro<n>Dober
continues to act strangely, and<n>she does rather
poorly during our<n>training session...
